messages.text: Afternoon all. Quick sync on Osprey buyer outreach. Where are we on the strategic list vs. the sponsor list? Want to get first-wave calls scheduled before Friday.
Strategic list is at 14 names after the last round of edits. Sponsor list is 22, but I think we can trim to ~15 once we screen for fund vintage and dry powder. Tracker is updated in the deal folder.
I'm finishing the dry powder screen now. Should have the trimmed sponsor list to you by 3pm. A few funds are deep into their investment periods so I'm flagging those as lower priority.
Teaser and NDA template are both with legal for a final look. Expect them back tomorrow morning. Once cleared we can start sending to first-wave strategics.
Good. Can we make sure the teaser language on EBITDA adjustments matches the latest management case? I saw a slightly different bridge in the draft CIM.
Yes, I'll reconcile the teaser against the CIM bridge today. I think the draft teaser still has the old run-rate add-back. Will fix and send a redline.
One thing on sequencing: I'd like to hold two of the largest strategics for a second wave, so we don't create a bidding dynamic too early. Thoughts?
Agree in principle. Let's pull the top two off wave one and bring them in after we've gauged sponsor appetite. Robert, can you draft the wave plan?
Will do. I'll have a one-pager by end of day with wave timing and who owns each call.
Trimmed sponsor list is posted in the folder. 16 names, with notes on fund size and sector focus. Four are marked as likely pass based on recent portfolio overlap.
Nice, thanks Susan. A couple of those overlap with names we're approaching on Kestrel, so let's coordinate to avoid hitting the same people with two processes in one week.
Good catch. I'll check the Kestrel outreach calendar and flag any conflicts. We may want to stagger by a few days for the shared contacts.
Redline on the teaser is up. Swapped in the current adjusted EBITDA figure and updated the footnote on add-backs. Tom, can you check it ties to your model?
Looks tied out on my end. One small nit on the footnote wording but I'll leave a comment in the doc.
Great progress, everyone. Plan: legal clears documents tomorrow, Robert's wave plan tonight, Tom confirms Kestrel overlaps. Let's regroup Thursday at 10 to lock the first-wave call list.
